question.text: The quadratic expression $(2 x+1)^{2}-p x+q \neq 0$ for any real $x,$ if

solution.text:
Given equation is $(2 x+1)^{2}-p x+q \neq 0$
$$
\begin{array}{lr}
\Rightarrow & 4 x^{2}+4 x+1-p x+q \neq 0 \\
\Rightarrow & 4 x^{2}+(4-p) x+(1+q) \neq 0
\end{array}
$$
